items.author: Michael McCusker, Oct 31
items.summary: "Do you like scary movies?" Halloween movie-data dashboard set in a cemetery, with animations and easter eggs, built as a Tableau data app (beta) running natively in Tableau Cloud; he admits the new Tableau AI capabilities scare him a little as a developer. Public copy: https://www.michael-mccusker.com/do-you-like-scary-movies. 20 reactions, 3 comments.

items.author: Sweety Antoni David, ~Oct 27
items.summary: Six custom Power BI KPI card designs built from scratch with custom visuals, with no third-party visuals or HTML, keeping native slicer, tooltip and cross-filter behavior and Format-pane settings; downsides are slow setup and code upkeep (credits Faizaan Fareed). 204 reactions, 43 comments, 6 reposts.

items.summary: VP, Enterprise Data & Analytics — TradeStation — Remote, but residency limited to FL, TX, IL, NY, NJ, CO, ID, MA, MI, MN, MO, NC, SC, UT and VA (Pennsylvania not eligible) — Reposted Nov 1 — No salary listed — Hands-on VP over data science, analytics, data products and AI-ready foundations (semantic layer, pipelines), managing Director and Sr Director leaders; BI fluency across Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Sigma; governance, cloud. Not Power BI-heavy.
